title: GentleOS – Classic operating system with a lovely retro GUI
summary: GentleOS is a retro-style 32-bit operating system project featuring a classic graphical user interface, designed to evoke nostalgia for traditional desktop operating systems from the late 1990s/early 2000s era.
problem_solved: Provides a nostalgic retro computing experience and serves as an educational project for understanding operating system and GUI development fundamentals.
why_valuable: Offers retro computing enthusiasts and developers a charming recreation of classic OS aesthetics while learning low-level system programming.
